stem.text: Which statement about the compounds of Group 2 elements magnesium to barium is correct?

A.text: Carbonates of Group 2 elements produce bubbles when added to dilute nitric acid.

B.text: Nitrates of Group 2 elements produce nitrogen and oxygen on heating.

C.text: Oxides of Group 2 elements produce bubbles when added to dilute hydrochloric acid.

D.text: The oxides of Group 2 elements are amphoteric.
